set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: Q01.2
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer with scientist and operator
Scope: Implement a parameterized harness for the frozen local engineering profile first; later institutional data/targets are evaluated separately in Q01.3.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: Q01 (bd-01M4W40KZWFPTRA33A443C4DM8)
Suggested delivery tranche: T4; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Exercise realistic labs/roles/grants, concurrent readers and writers, import/export, selective discovery/query, revision growth and long-lived downloads.
2. Record hardware, dataset/workload seed, cache conditions, sample counts, latency distributions, memory, bytes and database contention; include authorization and response cost.
3. Automate interruption, expiry, queue pressure and limit-exceeded cases while retaining correctness oracles; do not increase the 10000-entry ceiling without a qualified implementation change.

Verification: Reproducible harness and sample source-bound reports with calibration of counters/timing and demonstrated failure detection.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/Q01.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/evidence/query-scale-summary.json
- docs/prd.md
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- H04.1: bd-01M4X8MAT0FE5J2NXNWK4ZXTH8
- F06: bd-01M4W40JXJ4C805E7NBZ0WCDMF
- W02.1: bd-01M4W5PB5NYNV2A8EFBQKXPEBZ
- O02.3: bd-01M4W5P8F383C1WSQ1KBH0Q6WW

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
